sentences.text: Paracoracias is an extinct genus of coraciiform birds, a group related to kingfishers and bee-eaters.
The genus was described by Clarke and colleagues in 2009 based on fossils found in the Green River Formation of Wyoming.
It belongs to the order Coraciiformes and sits within the parent group Coracii. The type species of the genus is Paracoracias occidentalis.
This bird lived during the Ypresian stage of the Eocene epoch.
